articleBodyHtml:
Design and Usability

The design of the product has been positively received, with users commenting on its aesthetic appeal and practicality for desk use. One user noted, 'That's very nice,' while another added, 'That's good for like on desk.' These comments indicate that the product is not only visually appealing but also functional in a typical workspace setting.

The product's height was also a point of discussion, with users appreciating that it is not too tall. One user remarked, 'So that's not too tall, but you can still have your phone on it,' which suggests that the product is designed with user convenience in mind. This feature is particularly useful for those who need to place their phone on the product while using it.

Print Quality and User Impressions

The print quality of the product has been highly praised, with one user stating, 'It's really good print quality,' and another expressing their admiration by saying, 'I'm impressed.' These comments highlight the high standards of the product's manufacturing and the attention to detail that has gone into its production.

Customization and Fan Engagement

The product offers customization options, allowing users to create a unique fan case. As one user mentioned, 'So you can customize your own unique fan case,' which is a significant feature for fans looking to personalize their items. This customization capability is especially appealing for those who want to showcase their support for their favorite VTubers.

Fan engagement is a key aspect of the product's appeal, with users expressing a desire to meet their favorite VTubers. One user stated, 'I want to see you guys with these,' which indicates a strong emotional connection between the fans and the VTubers they support.

Environmental Responsibility and Community Involvement

The company is committed to environmental responsibility, as evidenced by their employees organizing beach cleaning activities. One user noted, 'So in addition, their employees also organize beach cleaning activities regularly, personally clearing the garbage that has drifted to the shore, and taking personal actions to protect our environment.' This demonstrates a proactive approach to environmental stewardship.

Product Features and Emergency Use

The product has unique features that make it useful in emergency situations. For example, the Aqua stand can be used to open a watermelon in emergencies, as one user mentioned, 'Yes, you can definitely use it to open the watermelon in emergencies.' This highlights the versatility of the product and its potential for unexpected uses.

Fan Interaction and Exclusive Items

Fan interaction is a crucial part of the product's marketing strategy, with users being encouraged to stick to their favorite VTubers (Oshis) to receive exclusive items. One user advised, 'So stick to your Oshis lineup so that you'll be able to get the acrylic,' which indicates that the company is offering exclusive items to fans who support specific VTubers.

Product Availability and Limited Editions

The product's availability is limited, with users being encouraged to preorder early to secure their items. One user noted, 'back to the slides over here, but they are limited,' which suggests that the product is in high demand and that there is a limited quantity available.

Product Promotion and Fan Excitement

The product has generated a lot of excitement among fans, with users expressing their enthusiasm for the new product. One user stated, 'I hope you guys will check it out and look forward to it,' which indicates that the product is highly anticipated and that fans are eager to see it.
